title: Three steps. No agency fog.
lede: You are running a business while this gets built. Each step has a job, and you always know whether we are listening, building or getting ready to launch.

steps.name: Consultation
steps.title: We start with your customers
steps.body: We look at how people find you, what they need to do, and what is getting in the way. The recommendation is the simplest build that does that job.
points: How a customer moves from first visit to enquiry
What the business needs the system to do this year
Where a simpler approach will do
What is worth fixing before anything new is added

steps.name: Development
steps.title: We build something your team can live with
steps.body: You see the work as it comes together. It works on the phones your customers actually use, and it stays faithful to your brand.
points: Clear on phones, tablets and desktops
Built with current HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Straightforward for the person who will update it

steps.name: Launch
steps.title: You can run it after we leave
steps.body: We test it with you before anyone else sees it. If there is a content system, we train the people who will use it.
points: Checked on the devices your customers use
Nothing goes live until you are happy
Training so your team can publish
A month of free defect fixes, then support if you want it
